about: Independently authored English sentences from a hackathon juror perspective. These cases probe everyday intentions, uncommon actions, physical motion, and fantasy scenes. Noun checks describe the intended player, another role, either role when the player is unspecified, or the setting; each verb check records observable controls or mechanics that would realize the action. Authored without implementation, plans, or other evaluation corpora.
